Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan southbound when it struck the front of a pickup truck traveling northbound in the
same lane, a low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas. Driver 2, the operator of the pickup, was present at
the scene and confirmed the sequence of events as Driver 1 described them. Two independent witnesses gave
statements consistent with that account, and scene photographs were taken and placed in the file. Passenger was
seated in the rear of the sedan and was also confirmed present by the responding officers and both witnesses.
Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness shortly after the impact and was transported for evaluation. The complaint is
consistent with the kind and force of a frontal impact of this type. Damage to the front of the sedan and the front of the
pickup corresponds to the reported point and direction of contact. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or
reported by any party. Records checked at the scene show Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering
the sedan.
</page>
